description:
API version and URL base path information:
- `version`  > major.minor.patch, such as 2.0.0 (see Semantic Versioning Specification)
- `base` > relative URL base part (RFC 3986), extends as a header part all API endpoint urls, depends on the API version, may also include a URI-Template

templates.description: URI-Template, defining **each** in the URL used varspec variable
